scope: Monthly import unit values for support and precursor materials on the academic (reference) price basis. Each series is one HS 6-digit code reported by the United States (reporter 842) for imports from the world (partner 0), customs value divided by net weight. All grades and partners are combined, so a series is a bulk market level, not a catalyst-grade quote.

HS281820.name: Calcined alumina (non-corundum), U.S. import unit value
HS281820.grade_note: Dominated by smelter-grade flows; catalyst-carrier gamma alumina trades above this level.

HS282300.name: Titanium oxides, U.S. import unit value
HS282300.grade_note: Pigment grade dominates; anatase catalyst grades trade above this level.

HS281122.name: Silicon dioxide, U.S. import unit value
HS281122.grade_note: Precipitated, fumed and gel silicas combined.

HS380210.name: Activated carbon, U.S. import unit value
HS380210.grade_note: All grades combined; catalyst-support grades trade above this level.

HS284210.name: Synthetic zeolites and aluminosilicates, U.S. import unit value
HS284210.grade_note: HS 2842.10 is broader than zeolites (detergent builders, molecular sieves).

HS251990.name: Magnesia (fused or dead-burned), U.S. import unit value

HS284610.name: Cerium compounds, U.S. import unit value
HS284610.grade_note: Oxide, carbonate and chloride combined; kept beside the USGS cerium-oxide anchor rather than replacing it.

HS282010.name: Manganese dioxide, U.S. import unit value

HS281990.name: Chromium oxides and hydroxides (excluding trioxide), U.S. import unit value

HS281810.name: Artificial corundum (alpha-alumina), U.S. import unit value
HS281810.grade_note: Abrasive and refractory grades dominate the volume.
